people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

translations.web: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
translations.bsb: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
translations.kjv: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
translations.asv: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. And the men were sore afraid.
